output.summary: A perennial climbing vine native primarily to subtropical and temperate East Asia, kudzu has tuberous, starch-rich roots and stems that root on contact with soil. Its starchy root has been eaten in China since before 540 CE and is still made into starch, flour, noodles and Japanese sweets.
